description: This Java class 'HookHelper' provides utility methods for managing webhooks within the Fineract project's integration tests. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and verifying webhooks via REST API calls, utilizing request and response specifications. The class also constructs webhook JSON payloads with configurations and event details. It is marked as deprecated, indicating it's intended for testing purposes and may be replaced by a client library in the future.

classes.name: HookHelper
classes.description: Utility class for managing webhook operations in Fineract integration tests, including creating, updating, deleting, and verifying webhooks via REST API calls.

methods.name: createHook
methods.description: Creates a webhook with the specified payload URL by performing a server POST request, and returns the resource ID of the created hook.

methods.name: updateHook
methods.description: Updates an existing webhook identified by hookId with a new payload URL via a server PUT request.

methods.name: deleteHook
methods.description: Deletes the webhook identified by hookId via a server DELETE request.

methods.name: verifyHookCreatedOnServer
methods.description: Verifies that a webhook with the given hookId exists on the server by fetching its details and asserting the ID matches.

methods.name: verifyUpdateHook
methods.description: Verifies that the update to a webhook was successful by comparing the fetched config's fieldValue with the expected update URL.

methods.name: verifyDeleteHook
methods.description: Verifies that a webhook was successfully deleted by attempting to fetch its details and expecting a 404 'not found' error.

methods.name: getTestHookAsJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing a webhook payload with a specified URL, including configuration and trigger events.
